# scaling_oncall_schedule (Resource)

Manages an on-call schedule with rotation layers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scaling_oncall_schedule" "primary" {
  name        = "Primary On-Call"
  description = "Primary on-call rotation for the platform team"
  timezone    = "America/New_York"

  layer {
    name                 = "Tier 1"
    rotation_type        = "weekly"
    rotation_length_days = 7
    handoff_time         = "09:00"
    effective_from       = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    participant_ids      = ["user_abc", "user_def"]
  }

  layer {
    name                 = "Tier 2 - Backup"
    rotation_type        = "weekly"
    rotation_length_days = 7
    handoff_time         = "09:00"
    effective_from       = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    participant_ids      = ["user_ghi", "user_jkl"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the schedule.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone for the schedule (e.g. "America/New_York").

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `layer` (Block List) Rotation layers within this schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--layer))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the schedule.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns this schedule.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.

<a id="nestedblock--layer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layer`

Required:

- `effective_from` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when this layer becomes active.
- `handoff_time` (String) Time of day for rotation handoff in HH:MM format.
- `name` (String) Display name of the layer.
- `participant_ids` (List of String) Ordered list of participant user IDs for the rotation.
- `rotation_length_days` (Number) Length of each rotation in days.
- `rotation_type` (String) Rotation type: "daily", "weekly", or "custom".

Optional:

- `effective_until` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when this layer expires.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the layer.
- `updated_at` (String)
